kaikki_vikisozluk.e: قَفْقَفَ • (qafqafa) Iq (non-past يُقَفْقِفُ (yuqafqifu), verbal noun قَفْقَفَة (qafqafa))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From a reduplicated onomatopoeic root ق ف ق ف (q f q f). Compare قَرْقَفَ (qarqafa, “shiver”), غَرْغَرَ (ḡarḡara, “gurgle”), وَسْوَسَ (waswasa, “whisper”), قَمْقَمَ (qamqama, “grumble”).
s: ق ف ق ف (q f q f)
g: to be desiccated, to be exsiccated

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: قَفْقَفَة • (qafqafa) f
g: verbal noun of قَفْقَفَ (qafqafa, “to shiver, to chatter”) (form Iq)
